cause_quote: It changed the drop-tint selector from `.new-session-page__composer::after` to `.new-session-page__composer > .agent-chat__input::after`, the same pseudo-element that `.agent-chat__input--dictating::after` in composer.css uses for the dictation border, overriding it with opacity 0 and inset 0.
user_saw: Starting dictation in New Session no longer showed the animated recording border around the message box.
summary: Moves the New Session image-drop tint from the message input's ::after to its unused ::before so it no longer overrides the dictation border.
reasoning: At 1f3524e's parent, composer.css already drew the dictation border with `.agent-chat__input--dictating::after`, and the drop tint lived on the composer shell's own ::after. 1f3524e (#200758) retargeted the tint to `.agent-chat__input::after` with a more specific selector, so the tint rules replaced the border's styles; the fix PR describes the same mechanism and adds a red/green regression for it.
